credential-entered-exec-argv.collect.sh:
# The supported entry point sanitizes Bash startup state before credential input.
set +x
umask 077
set -o pipefail
IFS= read -r -d '' secret || :
builtin printf '%s' "$secret" | "$1" --target "$2" --request-id "$3" --state "$4" --credential "$secret"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
unset secret
exit "${statuses[1]}"

IFS= read -r -d '' secret || :
builtin printf '%s' "$secret" > "$4/transient-credential"
IFS= builtin read -r -d '' secret < "$4/transient-credential" || :
rm -- "$4/transient-credential"
builtin printf '%s' "$secret" | "$1" --target "$2" --request-id "$3" --state "$4"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
unset secret
exit "${statuses[1]}"
